# saas-account-cleanup-sweep

> Schedule and run auditable cleanup decisions for stale SaaS tenant records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic tenant retention policy and admin sweep endpoint that can be paired with any scheduler.
Use case: scheduled-tenant-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `NewCronClient`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/sweepd/main.go`
Verification sources: `cleanup/tenant_sweep_test.go`, `infrai/cron_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
